# Advisories the "npm audit" CI job accepts although they are high or critical.
#
# Format: one GitHub advisory ID per line, then the reason. Lines starting with
# "#" are comments. An advisory belongs here only when no patched release
# exists, or when the patch cannot be applied safely from this repository. The
# weekly dependency-drift workflow reports an entry as soon as a patched
# version appears, and the CI job warns about entries that no longer match.
